CustomField.formula: IF( Data_Quality_Score__c = 100, "All Case Details Captured", "Missing: " & IF(LEN(AccountId)=0, "Associated Account, ", "") & IF(LEN(ContactId)=0, "Associated Contact, ", "") & IF(ISPICKVAL(Brand__c, ""), "Brand, ", "") & IF(LEN(Contract__c)=0, "Contract, ", "") & IF(ISPICKVAL(Country__c, ""), "Country, ", "") & IF(LEN(OwnerId)=0, "Owner, ", "") & IF(ISPICKVAL(Status_Reason__c, ""), "Status Reason, ", "") & IF(LEN(Subject) =0, "Subject Line, ", "") & IF(LEN(SuppliedEmail)=0, "Email, ", "") )
